product.name: Monoprice Select Series DisplayPort to HDTV Cable 2m (6.6ft) 4K@60Hz
product.description: This Monoprice Select Series DisplayPort™ to HDTV Cable connects your computer to HDMI®-equipped TV, video projector, computer display, or HDMI distribution device. It supports video resolutions up to 4K@60Hz and multichannel, lossless audio, such as Dolby TrueHD™ and DTS-HD Master Audio™.Important: This is not a bidirectional cable.
